D.treatment: TDHS Strategic Reading double-dose reading program

O.outcome_detail: CTBS Terra Nova standardized test performance

cells.quote: The one qualifying study of TDHS in Baltimore found very positive outcomes for ninth graders in comparison to a control group on CTBS Terra Nova tests (effect size = +0.32).
cells.note: The text identifies a matched study with a control group but does not state that assignment was random.

O.outcome_detail: Teachers' perceived impact on student reading

cells.quote: Overall, teachers found the program to be positive and to have a greater impact on student reading than if they had used more traditional curricula.
cells.note: This finding comes from a short survey of nine ninth-grade teachers; no quantitative effect size or formal statistical comparison is reported.

D.comparison: educational staff and societal partner perspectives

O.outcome_detail: representation of participant perspectives in the reviewed studies

cells.quote: Analyzing 36 studies published between 2006 and 2024, the review highlights a notable underrepresentation of the learning experiences of educational staff and societal partners.
cells.note: The study text reports that student perspectives were more represented than those of educational staff and societal partners, but does not provide the exact counts or percentages shown in the wiki entry.

O.outcome_detail: unsettling reactions and reflection on personal assumptions

cells.quote: First, responding to sustainability issues was unsettling for many students because it required they to reflect on their assumptions about consumption, race, gender, and other social issues
cells.note: The review reports a qualitative challenge rather than a treatment-versus-comparison effect; no comparator or effect size is stated.

D.treatment: complexity and uncertainty in transdisciplinary learning

O.outcome_detail: undesirable coping, including oversimplifying problems or omitting societal partners

cells.quote: These challenges encompass both emotional and cognitive dimensions, with uncertainty emerging as a central feature stemming from the complexity of sustainability issues and the unfamiliarity of the transdisciplinary learning process.
cells.note: The entry reports undesirable coping behaviors, but the supplied study text does not provide a comparator, quantitative effect, or pooled directional estimate.

O.outcome_detail: time required to build relationships and shared understanding

cells.quote: The review reports both students and societal partners tended to overestimate the time the other party could commit, and that building relationships and ensuring shared understanding were more time-consuming than in other types of learning.
cells.note: The quoted finding appears in the wiki entry, but the corresponding sentence is not present in the supplied study text. For learning-time, more time is coded as worse.
